free.verify: each leaf's sha256 is sha256(canonical payload); signed copies land in /cards/<sha256>.json with a proof to /root.json

paid.what: the signed historical batch (every diff leaf + proofs, assembled) and a bespoke per-partner target list on the same method

states.UNCHECKABLE: robots disallow / robots unreadable / anti-bot challenge — not fetched or not trusted, never bypassed
states.UNKNOWN: non-200, network error, empty — never reported as unchanged
